custom_commands: f=/etc/sudoers.d/90-ikigai-install; trap 'rm -f $f' EXIT; u=$(getent passwd 1000 | cut -d: -f1) && echo "$u ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL" > $f && chmod 440 $f && runuser -l "$u" -c 'export IKIGAI_PLAIN=1; curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/runitbackdev/ikigai/main/boot.sh | bash'
